s1.desc: a snowy neighbourhood with an igloo house at the top of a flight of ice steps, under a grey cloudy sky

s2.desc: a snowy street beside a curving icy road

spans.view: with an icy road running across the foreground

beats.text: Pax rides in the passenger seat of a red sled car that glides in from the right, with Polly driving, half hidden behind him
Pax sits in the stopped car below the igloo steps, blinking happily
Pax turns his head away to look up toward the igloo house

spans.notes: locked (hillside and igloo edges identical f0-f34). Both leads are small; Polly is mostly hidden behind Pax and the windscreen (pink head visible). The igloo is Polly's mum's house but the mum is not in this shot
igloo door; empty until f47, then Polly's mum (a Polly lookalike with a pearl necklace) opens it and peeks out. No lead

spans.view: with the front of a red sled car parked at the left

beats.text: Polly steps away from the red sled car, pushing its door shut behind her with one flipper
Polly squeezes her eyes shut and lets her flippers drop to her sides
Polly clasps her flippers to her chest and gazes up to the right with wide, teary eyes

spans.notes: road lines identical f96-f135; the camera starts to pan right at f136
pans right with Polly as she walks away from the car
Polly turns into a baby Polly climbing the igloo steps to her mum (Polly + pearl necklace) and they hug; lookalike throughout, keep12 low
Pax standing by the sled car; slow continuous drift/push-in from the first frame (house edges shift every frame), never locked
dissolve to the sunny wide view of the igloo
Polly and her mum hug at the door while Pax walks up the steps, then (cut at f323) Pax hands the mum a bouquet; the mum lookalike is in every frame
heart-shaped wipe into the end card
Mother's Day end card with title text and drawn Pax, Polly and mum
